feedback:
OK, so looks good - a couple problems.  when I said every pane gets the above and below padding - you need to parameterize that.  Here it is good for the content, but not for the heading with the categories.  I didn't intend that you apply it there.  Now that I think of it, I think that the problem is that I see the headings as being a part of the list pane, not as a separate pane.  Put them in the same pane, which removes this first horizontal line, then there is 1 line above and below the heading, followed by the list. 
Regarding the histograms, what the fuck is this?  This is fucking ugly as shit.  We have so much width to use here, and you've crushed the histograms into something unreadable.  You had the correct size before, I just asked you to add the bytes next to it... this is exactly as it comes out in the tool.  Note that the terminal width needs to be 160-180 chars to get the right render.
The line "chosen:" needs to have a verticle space before it, as it bumps into the legend here.
